brief.headline: GIFT Nifty Plunges Over 200 Pts as Global Tech Selloff Hits Asian Markets
brief.summary: Indian equities are set for a sharp gap-down opening following a heavy overnight selloff in US markets and steep declines across Asian equities. GIFT Nifty indicates a drop of over 200 points despite Nifty rising 1.14% to 25514.3 in the previous session. Persistent inflation concerns and broader tech market weakness continue to weigh on global investor sentiment.

takeaways.text: GIFT Nifty fell over 200 points, signaling a sharp downward start for Indian benchmarks after Nifty gained 1.14% to 25514.3 yesterday.
US markets fell overnight with Nasdaq dropping 2.25% and S&P 500 down 2.02% amid rate hike expectations.
India CPI hit a two-year high of 6.1% in October, with forecasts indicating retail inflation above 6% through March.
Anthropic raised $81.3 billion through an offer of 980 million shares, reaching a valuation of $2 trillion in its debut.
Tata Tech targets $1.1-1.3 billion revenue by FY30 compared to approximately $620 million in FY26.
Asian tech stocks fell despite Anthropic's debut, with Nikkei 225 plunging 4.49% on persistent AI sector concerns.

sections.india: Indian equity markets are poised for a steep opening drop as GIFT Nifty slid over 200 points. The previous session saw Nifty gain 1.14% to 25514.3 while Sensex climbed 1.21% to 83021.75. However, macro headwinds persist with India October CPI at 6.1%, alongside Paytm and Pine Labs dropping up to 7% on UPI MDR deferral concerns. Meanwhile, Tata Tech targets revenue of $1.1-1.3 billion by FY30.
sections.world: Global equities faced a steep selloff with S&P 500 falling 2.02% and Nasdaq dropping 2.25%. Asian benchmarks tracked Wall Street lower, with Nikkei 225 plunging 4.49% and Hang Seng slipping 1.96%. Gold tumbled to 3552.4, down 5.06%, heading for its worst weekly decline since March amid expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes.
sections.tech: Anthropic completed a blockbuster IPO raising $81.3 billion across 980 million shares to reach a $2 trillion valuation on Nasdaq. However, Asian chip and tech stocks dropped as Anthropic's debut failed to ease broader AI trade concerns. Anthropic shares also dropped over 3% in after-hours trading as Apple plans an autonomous AI agent.

stories.title: Anthropic shares surge 34% in Nasdaq debut, valuation hits $2 trillion

The company raised a remarkable $81.3 billion through the sale of 980 million shares to investors. Today's guests are Class V Group Founder Lise Buyer, Menlo Ventures Partner Matt Murphy, GIC Head of Technology Investment Group Chris Emanuel, Goldman Sachs Chief Credit Strategist Amanda Lynam, Robinhood Markets CIO Stephanie Guild, Warrington College of Business…
stories.ai_summary: Anthropic made its highly anticipated debut on the Nasdaq after completing its record-setting public offering.
stories.why_it_matters: Focus shifts to post-market performance and secondary market trading dynamics.

stories.title: Anthropic raises $81bn in record IPO
stories.summary: Shares in AI giant set to begin trading on Thursday after company sells shares at $1.5tn valuation in blockbuster listing
stories.ai_summary: AI giant Anthropic raised $81 billion in a record-breaking public listing valued at $1.5 trillion.
stories.why_it_matters: Benchmark transaction for valuation of generative AI infrastructure companies.

stories.title: Anthropic's $1.5 trillion debut rewrites venture capital's playbook
stories.summary: The AI lab's shares began trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday at a $1.5 trillion valuation, delivering multibillion-dollar windfalls to venture investors at a moment when the industry needs fresh liquidity to fund more bets on AI companies. The stock closed at $97.17, up 17% from its IPO price of $83.
stories.ai_summary: Anthropic's $1.5 trillion listing delivered multibillion-dollar liquidity windfalls to venture capital investors. The debut marks a major exit event for early backers in the tech ecosystem.
stories.why_it_matters: Provides fresh venture capital liquidity after extended dry spells in tech exits.

stories.title: A brief history of Nvidia’s recent stock fluctuations
stories.summary: "We've got this," Colette Kress, interim CEO of Nvidia, said Tuesday night as she closed out the embattled chip company's third quarter earnings call. By Thursday, the company's stock price was hovering at around $150 per share, a nearly 40 percent drop from its all-time high on October 6th, and wiping out a brief post-earnings […]
stories.ai_summary: Nvidia experienced stock fluctuations following its Q3 earnings call addressed by interim CEO Colette Kress. Investors remain focused on execution and leadership transitions.
stories.why_it_matters: Key benchmark for semiconductor sentiment and AI hardware capital expenditure.

stories.title: Asian Chip Stocks Slide as Anthropic IPO Fails to Dispel AI Woes
stories.summary: Asia’s chip-related shares resumed their selloff on Friday despite Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster listing, a sign that concerns about the artificial intelligence trade, which have been building for months, continue to dominate investor sentiment.
stories.ai_summary: Asian semiconductor shares resumed their selloff on Friday despite Anthropic's blockbuster debut. Persistent concerns over AI valuations continue to weigh on regional chipmakers.
stories.why_it_matters: Indicates broader tech sector fatigue despite mega cap primary market listings.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
stories.summary: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information. CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm "in time for the holidays in December," but […]
stories.ai_summary: Meta is considering pricing its upcoming Muse Charm hardware device at $300. The screen-equipped gadget will allow users to interact directly with Meta's AI agent.
stories.why_it_matters: Tracks consumer hardware adoption and monetization models for AI products.

stories.title: Japanese Shares Slide as AI Concerns Overshadow Anthropic Debut
stories.summary: Japanese equities slumped with tech-related shares hammered as concerns around the artificial intelligence trade linger despite the strong debut of Anthropic’s listing on the stock market.
stories.ai_summary: Japanese equities slumped on Friday as ongoing worries regarding AI profitability overshadowed Anthropic's debut.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative sentiment in Japanese tech spillovers to Asian emerging market equity flows.

stories.title: Anthropic revenue target: $600bn, soonish
stories.summary: Plus, chip export controls
stories.ai_summary: Anthropic outlined an ambitious revenue target of $600 billion amid ongoing international chip export controls.
stories.why_it_matters: Ambitious top-line targets underscore long-term expectations for AI commercialization.

stories.title: Anthropic's Australian data centre overwhelmingly opposed by residents
stories.summary: Of nearly 600 public submissions on the proposed Western Downs Digital Park, about 250 km (155 miles) west of Brisbane, two expressed support for the project and one was neutral, according to the filing. The remaining 595 opposed it or asked for a delay until developers cleared certain environmental hurdles, the filing said.
stories.ai_summary: Public filings show that of nearly 600 submissions on Anthropic's Western Downs Digital Park data centre in Australia, almost 250 km west of Brisbane, only two expressed support.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates community and ESG pushback facing global data center expansion projects.

stories.title: Alibaba defrauded shareholders by concealing ties to suspected spy in Nvidia scandal, lawsuit says
stories.summary: According to a proposed class action filed in Manhattan federal court, Alibaba inflated its share price by knowingly and materially understating in its 2024, 2025 and 2026 annual reports the risks that actual or suspected export control violations could harm its business.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO Rekindles Debate Over India’s AI Ambitions
stories.summary: Anthropic’s record-breaking IPO has triggered a debate among Indian business leaders on the country’s ability to build globally competitive AI…

stories.title: Anthropic Shares Drop Post-Market on Apple’s AI Agent Plans
stories.summary: Shares of Anthropic PBC fell more than 3% in after-hours trading following their New York debut, as Apple Inc. plans to develop an autonomous AI agent and investor caution over the AI trade weighed on momentum throughout the day.

stories.title: Propagate Co-CEO on New Sam Bankman-Fried Docuseries
stories.summary: Ben SIlverman, Propagate Co-CEO & Chairman, discusses Sam Bankman-Fried’s early investment in Anthropic, which he could not benefit from after FTX and Alameda Research were forced to sell their reported $500 million stake before FTX’s collapse. As Anthropic made its trading debut, executive producer Ben Silverman said the IPO reinforced that Bankman-Fried had a strong investing thesis, but compared his rise and fall…

stories.title: Could a Jensen Huang-Style Scandal Happen at Apple?
stories.summary: On the Power On podcast, Joanna Stern joins Mark Gurman to discuss Nvidia’s leadership fallout, Apple’s executive culture under Steve Jobs and Tim Cook and why Cupertino isn’t immune. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.title: Alibaba Expects Growth Rebound as Its Chips Offset US Curbs
stories.summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. expects AI-related revenue growth to recover by 2028 from a brief slowdown next year thanks to the growing sophistication of in-house semiconductors, joining Tencent Holdings Ltd. in seeking to dispel longer-term fallout from Washington’s move to restrict Chinese access to Nvidia Corp. chips.

stories.title: NEPRA Raises ₹110 Cr To Expand Plastic Recycling Capacity
stories.summary: Ahmedabad-based waste management startup NEPRA has raised ₹110 Cr (about $11.7 Mn) in an equity funding round from the Private…

stories.title: Razorpay To File UDRHP By Next Week, Eyes IPO By February 2027: Report
stories.summary: Fintech major Razorpay is reportedly looking to file its updated DRHP as early as next week, following the SEBI clearance…

stories.title: Minotaur's Rosenberg: Anthropic IPO Fuels Wider AI Trade
stories.summary: Minotaur Capital Co-Founder and Portfolio Manager Armina Rosenberg says Anthropic’s initial public offering supports confidence in the broader artificial intelligence trade despite near-term volatility. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.title: The City at the Center of AI
stories.summary: Anthropic’s record-setting IPO is expected to make many of its employees rich, and other AI companies may be next. At the center of this modern gold rush is San Francisco, a city used to booms and busts – but never at this scale. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO could deliver $156B to charity
stories.summary: At a stock price of $95, the frontier lab's Public Benefit Foundation, its employee donations, and the company's match tot up to $156 billion.

stories.title: California attorney general subpoenas Nvidia over chips, former CEO's affair
stories.summary: The California Department of Justice said on Thursday it is asking Nvidia whether its advanced chips or confidential information may have gone to China and whether Nvidia misled investors and the public.

stories.title: California Probing If Nvidia Misled Investors on China Risks
stories.summary: Nvidia Corp. is being investigated by California officials to determine whether any of its actions resulted in advanced chips or confidential information being improperly obtained by China.

stories.title: SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut
stories.summary: SoftBank shares plunged over 16% on Friday as Japanese and South Korean technology stocks fell sharply.

stories.title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
stories.summary: Anthropic's IPO price was set at $83, representing more than $80 billion in new capital raised.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need', but analysts warn of volatility
stories.summary: The Anthropic IPO is "what the markets need." However, analysts say its shares will be volatile in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
stories.summary: Google's latest update to Gemini brings an AI agent to the Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and tackle multistep workflows.

stories.title: With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic’s ‘good guy’ reputation is on the line
stories.summary: Today is a new beginning for Anthropic: a years-in-the-making IPO that beat out SpaceX for most valuable of all time, having raised $81.3 billion and set an important precedent for the other public AI lab debuts to come. But it's not simply a financial milestone. Anthropic was founded on the idea that it prioritized safety […]

stories.title: Jim Cramer says Nvidia has a new problem — and it has nothing to do with earnings
stories.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer warned that Anthropic's highly anticipated IPO presents another headwind for Nvidia.

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO puts AI’s circular financing boom to the test
stories.summary: Anthropic faces enormous compute commitments as it goes public, but its biggest infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Google, could continue profiting from AI even if Anthropic loses its lead.
